LanguageData.CS_NoMetalToGrasp: No line reaches there. There is no metal to grasp.
LanguageData.CS_MistsRetreat: The mists retreat with the rising of the sun.
LanguageData.CS_MistsArriveMessage: As night falls, a dense, ethereal mist blankets the land. At 20:00, they will settle. Pawns outside during the night may never be the same.
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Message: {PAWN} has snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_WitnessedDeath: {PAWN} witnessed the death of a loved one, and the trauma broke something open within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Prisoner: {PAWN} endured brutal treatment as a prisoner. The pain and desperation triggered a snap, granting access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_FirstKill: {PAWN} took a life for the first time. The shock of the act broke through a barrier within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Starvation: {PAWN} teetered on the edge of starvation. In their desperate struggle to survive, something within them broke open. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Downed: {PAWN} collapsed in the heat of battle. As consciousness faded, something awakened within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_LimbLoss: {PAWN} lost a part of themselves, and the trauma of that loss broke something open within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_RoofCollapse: {PAWN} was buried under a collapsed roof. Trapped and desperate, something within them shattered. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_FailedSurgery: {PAWN} endured a botched surgery. The shock and violation of it broke through a barrier within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_OrganHarvest: {PAWN} had an organ torn from their body. The violation shattered something deep within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_SocialFight: {PAWN} was beaten by someone they knew. The betrayal and pain broke something open within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Breakup: {PAWN} was devastated by the end of a relationship. The emotional wound cracked their spirit web. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Arrest: {PAWN} was arrested by their own people. The betrayal shattered something within them. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Lightning: {PAWN} was struck by lightning and survived. Raw energy coursed through them, cracking their spirit web wide open. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_ColonyDestruction: {PAWN} watched helplessly as the colony was torn apart around them. The anguish and loss broke something within. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Temperature: {PAWN} was pushed to the edge by extreme temperatures. As their body began to fail, something within them broke open. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.CS_PawnSnapped_Withdrawal: {PAWN} was wracked by the agony of withdrawal. Their body tearing itself apart cracked their spirit web. They have snapped and gained access to the Metallic Arts!
LanguageData.Cosmere_Scadrial_CopperRaidReduction: The coppercloud masked the colony's presence, reducing the raid's threat by {0}%.
LanguageData.Cosmere_Scadrial_CopperRaidReduction_Wit: The coppercloud masked the colony's presence, reducing the raid's threat by {0}%. {1} raiders arrived disoriented, confused by what they found.

LanguageData.CS_Savant_Allomancy_Stage1_Message: {PAWN} has burned {POWER} so frequently that it has begun reshaping {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. Allomantic abilities with {POWER} are growing stronger, but the metal's grip tightens.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Allomancy_Stage2_Message: {PAWN}'s body and spirit have become dependent on {POWER}. The enhanced power comes at a cost - without the metal burning, withdrawal will set in.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Allomancy_Stage3_Message: {PAWN} has burned {POWER} so extensively that it has permanently altered {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. The metal's power is extraordinary, but it has left permanent marks on {PAWN_possessive} body and mind.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Feruchemy_Stage1_Message: {PAWN} has stored and tapped {POWER} so frequently that the metalmind responds more readily. Feruchemical abilities are growing, but the bond to the metal deepens.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Feruchemy_Stage2_Message: {PAWN}'s spirit web has become deeply intertwined with {POWER}. Enhanced Feruchemical power flows through the metalminds, but storing now takes a heavier toll.
LanguageData.CS_Savant_Feruchemy_Stage3_Message: {PAWN} has used {POWER} metalminds so extensively that the art has permanently altered {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. Feruchemical power is extraordinary, but it has left permanent marks.
LanguageData.CS_BecameKoloss: {PAWN} is a koloss now. Whoever they were did not come back up off the table.
